name: voicetranser
description: Local push-to-talk voice input for macOS: hold a global hotkey, speak, release — transcription is pasted at your cursor. Fully local STT (Qwen3-ASR MLX, SenseVoice, mlx-whisper), zero external APIs. The bundled skill guides your agent through install, hotkey wiring, launchd setup and troubleshooting.
